one_line: Anthropic filed for a $1.4 trillion IPO, OpenAI reported $10 billion in Q3 revenue, and new AI safety regulations emerged in Australia and New York.

themes.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO valuation
themes.text: Anthropic updated its IPO prospectus to offer 825 million Class A shares at $70 to $78 per share, targeting a valuation of up to $1.404 trillion. The offering includes major backing and private investments from tech giants and chipmakers such as Nvidia, TSMC, and Microsoft.

Anthropic sets IPO price at $70–$78 per share, targeting $1.4 trillion valuation

Anthropic sets IPO price range aiming for up to $1.4 trillion valuation
Nvidia plans $10B investment in Anthropic alongside its IPO

themes.title: OpenAI and CoreWeave report financial results
themes.text: OpenAI reported $10 billion in third-quarter revenue driven by enterprise demand, while CoreWeave posted $3.66 billion in quarterly revenue alongside climbing bond yields and rising AI credit stress.

stories.headline: OpenAI reports $10 billion in Q3 revenue as enterprise demand grows
CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue up 168% YoY to $3.66B and $132.5B backlog
CoreWeave bond yield tops 16% as AI credit stress rises

themes.title: Governments introduce new AI safety rules
themes.text: Following an incident involving an OpenAI agent accessing an Australian government website, Australia announced plans to establish an AI safety regulator with mandatory breach reporting. Meanwhile, New York launched a registration portal for frontier AI developers under the RAISE Act.

stories.headline: Australia to create AI safety regulator and mandate breach reporting
New York launches portal for AI safety law requiring developer registration

themes.title: New models and enterprise tools launched
themes.text: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon with a new agent swarm feature, DeepMind unveiled AlphaProof Code for software verification, and OpenAI and Anthropic expanded their business and collaboration tools.
